meta.race: Ontario Honda Dealers Indy Toronto 2025 (NTT IndyCar Series)
meta.circuit: Streets of Toronto, 1.7 mi, 11 turns, concrete walls, notoriously bumpy, tight pit lane
meta.timebase_note: Caption timestamps are video time. Ad breaks are live. Official race time was 1:48:23.9 from green; video time at the checkered is a few minutes earlier than green+1:48 would predict, so drift of up to ~3 min is possible late in the race. Prefer lap_calibration and official_time_anchors over race_elapsed_s_est. Green laps are ~62-64 s.
source_caveats: Auto-captions: names, numbers and some laps are wrong; use driver aliases to normalize.
Lap numbers are only filled where the broadcast stated or clearly implied them; others are null or marked estimates.

The transcript has NO continuous brake, pressure or speed telemetry. braking_related events are qualitative (late/early/lockup/defense). Tire pressure only appears as two setup remarks. Use IndyCar API for real telemetry and use these events as labelled context.
Conflicting statements are flagged with stop_lap_conflict or confidence: low.
corrections_log: Grid/finish/stops now taken from the official classification (Palou started 2nd, not top-12 unknown; Armstrong 3rd; Simpson 2 stops).
Caution 4 start lap set to 37 and caution 5 to 89 per Fox RaceTrax.
Foster finished 21st (67 laps), not a DNF at the pileup; Daly and Robb are Juncos Hollinger, not ECR.

race_facts.event: Ontario Honda Dealers Indy Toronto, round 13 of 2025 NTT IndyCar Series
race_facts.circuit_history: Toronto street circuit spectator capacity ~73,000; 2025 was the last IndyCar race held at Exhibition Place per the circuit article.
race_facts.winning_margin_note: O'Ward won under yellow; VeeKay listed +0.4843 s, Simpson +1.5343 s (gaps compressed by the final caution).

forecast_only.source: AccuWeather forecast quoted by openwheelworld.net; a forecast, not an observed reading

observed_from_broadcast.overnight: Rain washed rubber off the circuit (broadcast, 6:34)
observed_from_broadcast.race: Commentary reports a dry race with no rain or wet-tire calls
observed_from_broadcast.grip_evolution: Fastest warm-up lap 1:06.12 (Lundgaard) vs pole 59.83 = about 6.3 s slower, then cars ran ~1:02 by lap 20; track ramped up quickly from a clean start

weather.gap: No observed race-day air or track temperature was found.

tires.note: Qualifying: O'Ward said the alternate was 0.7 s slower in Q2 than Q1 with no explanation (Crash.net).

fuel.home_lap_fuel_target_note: Palou team target: reach lap ~56 on the tank from the second stop

storylines: O'Ward's back-to-back wins (Iowa then Toronto); Arrow McLaren's first win at Toronto in the transcript's telling.
Simpson's first IndyCar podium after starting 13th; VeeKay's second place for Dale Coyne.
Ferrucci did not start after a hard warm-up crash (not cleared by IndyCar medical).
Newgarden's fourth crash in six races, per the broadcast.
Bird dropped on O'Ward's car before warm-up; he called it good luck (broadcast 1:59:03, Crash.net).
Rossi's wall contact: a lip in the concrete wall sheared the right rear (heavy debris, pits held closed).
Wheel-nut failure on McLaughlin's car on lap 2-3 triggered caution 1; Malukas had a wheel-fitting issue at his last stop (~lap 75).

stops_vs_finish_lead_lap.note: Averages are nearly identical; the spread within two-stoppers (P2 to P13) shows caution timing mattered more than stop count.

winner_profile.stop_condition: early green stop then two caution/green stops

events.detail: Ferrucci (23rd on grid) does not start; 26 starters, empty slot 23.
Overnight rain washed rubber off the circuit; wet-to-dry warm-up added no grip, so everyone effectively starts on a green track.
Only two of the top 12 start on the hard (black) tire: Palou and Foster (RLL). Everyone else on softs (green sidewall).
Broadcast estimate: soft tire lasts under 10 laps; teams hope for an early yellow to dump softs.
90-lap race; about 35 laps per tank of fuel. One stop only reaches ~70 laps, so at least two stops are needed.
Qualifying: Rahal starts 5th, Foster 7th.
Green flag. Herta (pole) leads. Lap 1 clean with no cautions.
Light wall nudge for Rosenqvist at turn 1 on lap 1.
Kirkwood passes Palou for 3rd on lap 1 (turn 3 area).
Rahal defends against Will Power on lap 1.
Armstrong defended hard in the turn-3 brake zone against Kirkwood; commentary flags possible defending-rule scrutiny (moving under braking).
Earliest stops after 2 laps: O'Ward, Ericsson, McLaughlin dump soft tires under green. Signals teams did not believe soft would last.
Caution 1: McLaughlin loses rear-left wheel after his stop and hits the wall. Broadcast: wheel nut not fully tightened (two attempts, released on third).
Pit lane opens under caution; O'Ward/Ericsson (already in), plus most of the field piles in.
Herta stop: clean, softs to hards, no adjustments. Exits first from pit lane.
Kirkwood smooth stop; Armstrong had a clear box and exits 2nd; Rahal described as a great stop (exits just behind Kirkwood).
Among drivers who stopped: O'Ward leads them (running 14th), then Ericsson, Siegel, Herta from 17th.

Non-stoppers at restart: Palou (hard) leads, VeeKay 2nd (soft), Foster (hard), Simpson 4th (soft). Malukas 5th, Dixon 6th. Stoppers are now behind, giving the "early stop" group clean-air disadvantage but a different strategy.
Restart 1: Palou leads on hards; excellent restart.
O'Ward passes Sting Ray Robb early after restart; makes up several places from the back.
Palou pulls 1.5 s clear of VeeKay in one lap after restart.
Palou estimated able to run about 30 laps on fuel and hard tires.
VeeKay on softs runs roughly a second per lap slower than Palou on hards.
Palou leads VeeKay by 3.4 s.
Soft tire on Simpson expected to fall off around lap 7-8 of the stint.
VeeKay soft tires fall off a cliff; pace dropping fast, he is passed by Malukas, Dixon, Schwarzman, Lundgaard, Newgarden, Rossi.
Palou needs ~25 s of lead over O'Ward this stint to afford a two-stop plan (extra-stop gap).
VeeKay pits (soft dead) under green. Simpson stays out on dying softs (commentary: a mistake).
Rahal goes around Robb, squeezes through the tight turn 3-4-5 section.
Caution 2: Power dives inside Rasmussen at turn 1; contact, bump into wall, Rasmussen spins with flat rear right and limps on.
Contact between Power (#12) and Rosenqvist (#60) damages the right side of Rosenqvist's front wing/end fence.
Simpson lost about 7 seconds in a couple of laps on collapsing softs (tire cliff magnitude).
Caution erases Palou's lead (gap to Foster reset to zero). Broadcasters note Simpson staying out may have slowed the field and aided Palou's gap.
Restart 2: Palou leads Foster; Dixon defends immediately; Lundgaard and O'Ward make early passes.
Herta passes Armstrong; Kirkwood also passes Armstrong a lap later; Malukas passes Foster for 2nd.
Malukas passes Foster for 2nd place.
Rahal defends turn 5 by braking super deep, taking away the inside from Rosenqvist.
Herta passes DeFrancesco on the run down to turn 3.
Someone runs wide ("overcooked it") while pushing; Herta chasing Ericsson on different strategy.
Foster radio during caution 2: wants more front wing at next stop; tires degrading slightly. Team: needs about 20 more laps on this stint.
Dixon has gained 13 places from 17th to 4th, on the same strategy as Palou.
Split: P1-8 (Palou, Malukas, Foster, Dixon, Lundgaard, Newgarden, Schwarzman, Rossi) on a two-stop; P9 backward on three stops. Early stoppers need two more stops.
Lap 21 of 90: Palou leads Malukas by 1.6 s.
Rossi up 16 places from start (last car yet to stop at that time).
Palou leads Malukas by 2.5 s.
Analysis: Palou likely needs another caution to make a two-stop; last year Dixon pitted lap 37 in a 85-lap race, this year 90 laps so soft stint would be ~20 laps.
Cars ahead run 1:02s; O'Ward reported running ~1:03s (fuel saving).
Malukas radio: team tells him not to short-shift out of turn 3 due to powertrain trouble in second gear.
Rosenqvist stops; front wing end fence broken; team leaves the wing unchanged; steady stop.
Shwartzman first of the leading pack to pit; had not quite reached lap 30.
Malukas second-fastest car on track, less than 0.1 s per lap slower than Palou, despite powertrain issue.
Nobody is on softs now, so Palou's team has no live read on how long a soft stint holds up.
Caution 3: Rossi brushes wall exiting a corner near turn 11; a concrete-wall lip catches the car, right rear destroyed, heavy debris across the front straight. Rossi: he tracked out a bit wide.
Lap 30 stated as one third of the race.
32 laps completed of 90 at this point in caution 3.
Pits closed until debris cleared (series holds pit lane closed so pitting drivers get no unfair advantage). Palou and Dixon told to stay out.
Foster: team asks to change front wing and make a tire pressure adjustment at this stop; go to black (hard) again (hard-hard plan).
O'Ward, Shwartzman and Rahal dove into pits just before the yellow (commit-line luck). Broadcast says O'Ward can now reach the end with one more stop.
events.note: transcript quotes lap 27/28 and lap 33 for O'Ward's stop

events.detail: As-run points snapshot mid race: O'Ward 170 points behind leader Palou.
Pits open. Palou and Dixon stay out; everyone else piles in. Foster in and out P2, Newgarden 3rd out.
Kirkwood spins entering pit lane while cutting inside the cone toward his box; Armstrong then tags him.
Armstrong contacts Kirkwood in pit lane.

Restart pileup at turn 1. Abel misjudges turn-in while being passed by Malukas; Foster goes straight into the barrier and up over Newgarden's rear; Abel's car ends on top of Newgarden's. DeFrancesco spins. Armstrong brakes to avoid and gets hit by Siegel. Kirkwood clips debris with left front.
At the pileup: cars that had NOT pitted under caution 3 were Palou, Dixon, VeeKay, Simpson, Daly, Power.
Newgarden DNF (his 4th crash in the last 6 races, worst stretch since 2014, innocent again). Abel's car lifted off Newgarden's.
Palou and Dixon have run 39 laps without stopping. Simpson, Daly (and Power slightly earlier) have now stopped.
Palou radio: yellow is helping fuel mileage; stay out; miles-per-gallon under yellow is what matters.
Before the pileup plan was ~5 more laps (to lap 40); with the yellow he could reach lap 44-45. Home-lap fuel target ~56, so only ~14 laps or fewer on softs.
Rossi: barely a snap, tracked out slightly wide, car destroyed (suspension cut, gearbox pulled apart).
Palou and Dixon pit under yellow after ~40 laps on first stint. Both take softs. Rejoin 18th-19th.
Restart 5 order VeeKay, Simpson, Daly, Power (top 4). O'Ward passes Power at turn 1. No push-to-pass allowed on first lap after a restart.
Power hits the wall while fighting; continues, avoiding another caution.
O'Ward passes Power and Daly in the first laps after restart; targeted by Team Penske Chevy stack.
O'Ward gets by Foster after resistance.
Foster hits wall, left rear damaged. Dixon gets by.
Push-to-pass seconds remaining: O'Ward 95, Simpson 145, VeeKay 141.
Order: VeeKay, O'Ward, Simpson, Daly, Shwartzman, Rahal, Rosenqvist, Malukas, Lundgaard, Ericsson.
O'Ward team boss: one more stop expected; O'Ward strong under braking.
VeeKay needs ~3-4 more laps of fuel savings to make a final stop work; still out at lap 51. He has ~3 laps less fuel than Simpson and Daly.
O'Ward pitted lap ~33; can stretch a ~30-lap stint on hard tires; risk: first car to pit for the last time forces others to cover.
On soft stint, Palou/Dixon lap times drop from mid 1:02s to 1:03.8 (twice); Dixon previous lap 1:04.0. Soft cliff after ~10-12 laps.
Ganassi strategy collapsing: falling pace on softs and no options left.
Palou pits (stop 2): Shell renewable fuel and hard Firestone. About a lap or two early to be safe; team target was 12 laps on softs and he got exactly 12.
VeeKay and Simpson have far more P2P left than O'Ward (89 s for O'Ward).
Dixon pits one lap after Palou; overcut works, Dixon beats Palou out of pit lane.
VeeKay is 4th-quickest car on track on that lap while burning P2P; fuel mileage on Honda praised.
VeeKay leads O'Ward by 1.1 s; then Simpson, Rahal, Ericsson, Herta, Power, Robb, Siegel.
33 laps to go.
VeeKay final stop; O'Ward stays out one more lap (attempted overcut). Commentary warns of cold hard-tire outlap lock-ups.
O'Ward final stop: hards and Shell fuel; clean out; driver says car feels good with changes from last stop. Rejoins ahead of VeeKay on strategy.
Simpson pits around the same time; VeeKay to the left on pit exit, O'Ward exits ahead of VeeKay.
VeeKay has ~25 s more push-to-pass than O'Ward for the last 31 laps.
Herta and Ericsson had stopped last on lap 33, same lap as O'Ward.
O'Ward leads VeeKay by 1.3-1.5 s after stops.
Broadcast: drivers move brake bias from the cockpit knob as tires wear; on a bumpy track some change it corner-by-corner (clockwise forward, counter-clockwise rearward).
Dixon 14th, Palou 15th: two-stop strategy lost all lead after repeated cautions.
Running championship lead for Palou 96 points (under 100), four races left.
Lap 66 of 90.
Malukas pitted lap 48; commentators doubt he makes the end without another stop.
Herta quietly makes his last stop and jumps to 5th ahead of teammate Ericsson.
23 laps to go: O'Ward leads VeeKay by 1.7 s. Malukas is 3rd but needs another stop.
Recap: O'Ward pitted early under caution and after the green passed Power and Foster at turn 1 repeatedly, brake-pedal heavy overtakes.
20 laps to go: O'Ward leads VeeKay by 2.5 s.
Shwartzman final (third) stop on soft after hard-hard: drops to 18th. Three stops total, all others made it in two or three.
Push-to-pass remaining: Rahal 57 s, Rosenqvist ~51-55 s, Simpson most with ~109 s (pitted late, has fuel and P2P to burn).
Simpson 0.2-0.3 s per lap slower than Herta; gap to Herta ~1.2 s with 17 to go (lap 73).
Malukas final stop bobbled: rear-right wheel not fully attached, outside rear tire changer struggled; car released anyway. He falls from 3rd to about 14th.
Rosenqvist locks up into turn 3, loses part of front wing; squeezes Palou at turn 4 and contacts Power again.
13 to go: O'Ward leads VeeKay by 3.0 s; Simpson 3rd, a couple of seconds clear of Herta.
Malukas on new tires passes several cars in one corner; on a tear through the field.
Tire-to-tire contact between Malukas and Lundgaard in turn 3-5 fight.
Palou backs off aggression after Lundgaard squeezed him wide at turn 7; regroups to protect the championship.
Lundgaard clips wall (small damage), then sideways moment with Rosenqvist; Armstrong makes it through.
Armstrong dives very late on the brakes on Lundgaard; touch.
Power makes an outside move on Palou completed under braking.
P2P: Power 75 s, Palou 65 s. Power pitted 3 laps later than the #10 car, so more fuel to use.
O'Ward 2.3 s ahead of VeeKay.
P2P: Simpson 46 s vs Herta 34 s. Herta has tires 4 laps fresher (late final stop).
3 laps to go: O'Ward, VeeKay, Simpson, Herta, Ericsson, Kirkwood, Rahal, Ilott, Malukas, Dixon.
Caution 5 at turn 10: Rosenqvist loses the rear, goes wide, brakes, and Siegel collides. Race finishes under yellow.
O'Ward wins under yellow; no damage to his car all race.
Podium: O'Ward, VeeKay, Simpson (first IndyCar podium for Simpson, biggest mover 13th to 3rd).
Palou: chose the strategy himself; started on hards to avoid traffic; opened a big gap after the first yellow but cautions erased it.
Final order top 12: O'Ward, VeeKay, Simpson, Herta, Ericsson, Kirkwood, Rahal, Ilott, Malukas, Dixon, Power, Palou.
Palou lead was 129 before the race, cut to 99 after Toronto. Kirkwood back to 3rd, Dixon 4th, Lundgaard 5th.

derived_metric_hints.tire_life_curve: events type=tire_degradation + laptime_s arrays: soft cliff onset ~laps 7-12 (VeeKay 8-10, Simpson 7-8 with ~7 s lost in 2 laps, Palou/Dixon ~11-12).
derived_metric_hints.overcut_undercut_score: events with overcut=True: Dixon over Palou (lap ~54), O'Ward over VeeKay (lap ~58).
derived_metric_hints.caution_luck_index: caution_start/pit windows: who had pitted just before yellow (O'Ward, Shwartzman, Rahal) vs who stayed out (Palou, Dixon).
derived_metric_hints.pit_quality: pit_stop.quality/pit_issue/pit_error events: McLaughlin wheel-off (lap 3), Malukas wheel fitting (lap ~75), Kirkwood pit-entry spin, Herta clean stop.
derived_metric_hints.push_to_pass_budget: push_to_pass events give seconds remaining for several drivers at several laps.
derived_metric_hints.gap_trend: gap events with gap_s for leader battles; join with API timing for lap-level.
derived_metric_hints.braking_style_counts: braking_related=True with brake_style in {late, late_lockup, late_successful}; treat as counts per driver, not rates.
